name: jundot/omlx
title: oMLX 0.8.0rc1 lets a Mac offload prefill to an NVIDIA GPU or DGX Spark over a LAN cable
summary: The oMLX release candidate adds a CUDA helper, started with one docker run on the NVIDIA box, that takes over prompt prefill while the Mac keeps decoding. On an M3 Ultra with a 64K prompt, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash prefill goes from 1,085 to 2,412 tok/s with a DGX Spark and to 1,914 with two RTX A6000s.

appearances.title: oMLX 0.8 uses an NVIDIA GPU to prefill for a Mac
appearances.summary: oMLX 0.8.0rc1 can hand prefill to an NVIDIA GPU or DGX Spark while the Mac keeps decoding, over ordinary Ethernet, and the GPU only needs to hold some of the layers. On a 64K prompt, an M3 Ultra plus a DGX Spark raised DeepSeek V4.1 Flash prefill from 1,085 to 2,412 tokens per second.
